Location: Bellevue, WA (onsite)

Pay Rate: $50/hr - $53/hr on W2 All Inclusive Danta Technologies payroll

No.of positions: 2

Note: This is not just a DBA or admin role — it's more of a data platform engineer with a strong specialization in Azure Data Explorer and telemetry data.

Job Description:
The client is seeking someone deeply experienced in ADX, as well as someone comfortable interfacing with data ingestion pipelines, KQL-based optimization, data quality monitoring, and governance. This role sits at the intersection of Data Engineering, Cloud Administration, and Security Data Operations.

The Azure Data Administrator role in Bellevue, WA (Onsite), the client is clearly seeking someone who combines deep expertise in Azure Data Explorer (ADX) with strong data operations, governance, and monitoring skills — particularly in the context of security telemetry and observability pipelines.

  • Review and validate the **Azure Data Explorer (ADX)** architecture to ensure scalability, resiliency, and performance. Recommend and implement approved changes to cluster sizing, partitioning strategies, and cache policies.
  • Ensure integration of data pipelines such as Vector, Event Hubs, Azure Blob, Cribl, NiFI ensuring high throughput and fault tolerance.
  • Develop and maintain "Kusto Query Language (KQL)” functions, materialized views, and time-series optimizations to support advanced querying and SIEM use cases.
